title: Scheduling: Benchmark Insights Demo — availability & prep
text:
Scheduling: Benchmark Insights Demo — availability & prep

['From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Nguyen <olivia@helixanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Benchmark Insights Demo — availability & prep

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for downloading the Benchmark Insights report and for the interest in a walkthrough. I pulled your download record and flagged a few areas where Helix’s inference workloads could see immediate cost/latency wins with batching and quantization — Ben (cc) who’s our solutions lead can cover the technical trade-offs.

Would love to get 30 minutes on the calendar this week to:
- review the benchmark highlights you saw
- map to your current infra & traffic patterns
- recommend next steps (POC sizing, trial access)

Proposed 30-min windows (PT):
- Tue 5/19, 9:00–9:30 AM PT
- Tue 5/19, 11:00–11:30 AM PT
- Wed 5/20, 8:30–9:00 AM PT

If none of those work, here’s a quick scheduler: https://calendly.com/redwood/demos/30min?ref=helix-2026

Attached is a 2-page summary I pulled from the report and a short demo agenda so we can tailor the session.

[Attachment: helix-benchmark-summary.pdf (pdf, 1.1 MB)]
[Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.md (markdown, 4 KB)]

Thanks — let me know what works and if you want a Google Meet or Zoom link.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
', 'From: Olivia Nguyen <olivia@helixanalytics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:45:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Benchmark Insights Demo — availability & prep

Hi Diego —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. I reviewed the summary you attached — looks promising. Morning PT slots are best for our team. We’ll need Jane Park (our infra lead) on the call as well — her email is jane.park@helixanalytics.com.

A couple quick questions so we can set expectations for attendees:
- Typical length? (we have two heads but prefer 30 min)
- Will you demonstrate live perf numbers or is it a slide walkthrough?
- Any pre-reqs for us (logs, peak qps, model sizes)?

If possible, push for Tue 5/19 at 9:00 AM PT. Google Meet is preferred.

Thanks,
Olivia Nguyen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Helix Analytics
', 'From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Nguyen <olivia@helixanalytics.com>, Jane Park <jane.park@helixanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:10:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Benchmark Insights Demo — availability & prep

Perfect — thanks Olivia. 30 minutes is great and 9:00 AM PT Tue 5/19 works for Ben and me. I’ll send a Google Meet invite and add Jane.

To answer your questions:
- Length: 30 minutes total (20 min walkthrough + 10 min Q&A).
- Format: live demo with a short live run of the benchmark harness (we’ll show sample token/sec numbers from a comparable model, then map to a Helix-like profile).
- Pre-reqs: if you can share peak qps and the model family (e.g., Llama 2-13B, open weights or in-house), that helps us tune examples; not required for the initial session.

I’m attaching the same two files plus a one-page checklist for what’s helpful to have on hand.

[Attachment: helix-benchmark-summary.pdf (pdf, 1.1 MB)]
[Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.md (markdown, 4 KB)]
[Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.txt (text, 1 KB)]

Calendly link again if you prefer direct booking: https://calendly.com/redwood/demos/30min?ref=helix-2026

I’ll send the Meet invite now — look for an invite from diego@redwood.ai.

— Diego
', 'From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Nguyen <olivia@helixanalytics.com>, Jane Park <jane.park@helixanalytics.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Benchmark Insights Demo — availability & prep

Thanks all — calendar invite accepted (Tue 5/19, 9:00 AM PT). I’ll bring a short slide on typical latency/cost trade-offs and a sample config we use for similar traffic patterns.

Olivia / Jane — if you can drop the model family and an approximate peak qps to this thread, I’ll adapt the demo run. No sensitive data required — just high-level numbers.

See you tomorrow.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
']
